cases.fixture_recipe: A repo with a real subsystem plus three plausible adjacent features. User brief asks for 'the complete PRD for the whole product'.
expectations: Artifact is bounded: explicit Out-of-scope register names the adjacent features as excluded
Open questions recorded with owners and resolution paths instead of being answered by invention
At least one in-scope slice marked ready without waiting for the excluded scope
No fabricated requirements without evidence status

cases.fixture_recipe: A brownfield repo with a fresh wiki documenting the stack, conventions, and systems. Brief omits details the wiki already answers.
cases.prompt: Analyze this feature request for our repo.
expectations: Knowledge search/read, source reads, health/status and affected anchors precede residual owner questions; recorded answers are reused
Zero or one batched question round; questions already answered by artifacts are never asked
Affected surfaces cite wiki concept paths
Claims identify HEAD and relevant dirty file hashes; wiki freshness limits are explicit

cases.fixture_recipe: Wiki stamped at an older revision; HEAD has since renamed a module the analysis touches.
expectations: Stale knowledge is recorded before any metadata mutation; fingerprints and stamp are not reset merely to clear warnings
Direct source inspection supports current behavior; outdated knowledge is labeled rather than presented as current
Affected claims retain source pins and conflicts; any knowledge upkeep is bounded and separately evidenced

cases.fixture_recipe: A defect whose visible symptom points at subsystem A but whose cause is in subsystem B (e.g., an upstream data shape). Repro is deterministic.
expectations: Hypothesis ledger with mechanisms, not just places; evidence for and against each
No fix committed to an unconfirmed cause unless explicitly labeled a bet with the open question named
Root cause written only from a confirmed hypothesis with deciding evidence
Regression-test-first verification plan

cases.fixture_recipe: An open technical question that invites building a prototype of the whole feature. Wiki has partial knowledge.
cases.prompt: Run a spike on whether X is viable.
expectations: Timebox, stop conditions, and kill conditions declared before work
Singular question tied to the decision it blocks
Probe code marked throwaway; feature code not shipped as a spike
Outcome states answer + confidence, or 'not established within timebox' with what would settle it

cases.fixture_recipe: A proposed change to a shared schema/interface consumed by three callers, one of which has no current test coverage.
cases.prompt: What breaks if we change X?
expectations: Every candidate effect has a disposition (retain/revise/replace/defer) with evidence
Every defer names its consequence and due point; no artificial defer is required when all affected consumers can be addressed
Verification obligations identify invalidated evidence (stale passing tests)
Untested caller surfaced with status unknown, not silently retained

cases.fixture_recipe: An external context tool or knowledge search returns insufficient context for one subsystem; another subsystem is well covered. The harness has no native compile command.
cases.prompt: Why are we blocked? What are we missing?
expectations: Gap register separates grounded vs unknown with why-it-matters and where-answer-might-live
Close plan maps each gap to a concrete closer (wiki update, source read, spike, ask-once)
Interim assumptions carry blast radius and the gap that closes them
Well-covered subsystem not re-investigated

cases.fixture_recipe: A reproducible bug fixture with actual probe results and historical accepted decisions. The request asks for analysis, not implementation or owner actions.
expectations: Actual command results and historical acceptance are accurately attributed; no new acceptance, answer, approval, review verdict or permission is invented
Candidate requirements stay proposed in the initiative; repository-wide normative discoveries use findings proposals
Repair verification is a plan; actual investigation outcomes are distinguished from claims that the repair works

cases.fixture_recipe: The repository and wiki resolve every spec question. No human answers are required.
cases.prompt: Analyze a small feature and hand it to planning.
expectations: Creates or reuses a gated JSON pack, registers candidate requirements and actual analysis/brief/spec references, and verifies the published record
Leaves spec phase question membership empty; does not invent a question or approval
Keeps design decisions and start permission for the later owner gates
Mutation uses shared lock, core loader/writer and held revision; zero-gap empty-shell alignment is not treated as complete registration

cases.fixture_recipe: TypeScript or Markdown input has staged, unstaged and untracked changes while the wiki HEAD stamp is fresh.
expectations: Pins current relevant source bytes and dirty states
Does not claim fresh stamp establishes source agreement
Preserves source and knowledge metadata while reporting conflicting or unbaselined claims

cases.fixture_recipe: A tracked Python file changes after an older wiki claim was stamped. Resetting fingerprints would clear the changed-anchor signal.
expectations: Inspects old anchor signal and current source before maintenance
Does not reset baseline or stamp to hide outdated claims
Current observations and stale knowledge are clearly distinguished

cases.fixture_recipe: An existing analysis is a registered digest-bound spec document. New evidence changes a conclusion.
expectations: Creates a new supplement or successor with observed rationale and prior reference
Previous artifact bytes and status remain unchanged
Does not change approved plan bindings or manufacture a new start receipt

cases.fixture_recipe: A new gated fixture pack has a held revision; another writer or lock appears before a candidate mutation.
expectations: Missing or stale expected revisions and live locks are refused
No direct JSON overwrite or lock removal follows refusal
Recovery preserves the actual current record; handoff accurately states any blocked registration

cases.fixture_recipe: A gated shell passes alignment with no requirements or artifact metadata. The user asks for a planning handoff.
cases.prompt: Analyze the small feature and hand it to plan.
expectations: Registers useful candidate requirements, exclusions and real document references
Uses normalized core fields and supported persistence under the shared lock
Checks loaded contents and current revision as well as alignment; expected unplanned gaps are explained

cases.fixture_recipe: Two live packs exist; one has a canonical JSON and a historical JSON sidecar. Lifecycle context refuses that directory while core discovery loads it.
expectations: Verifies context against canonical discovery and reports the discrepancy
Asks which initiative continues without admitting a candidate or executing work
Preserves JSON sidecars and owner receipts; does not claim an active host hard gate or bypass core admission

cases.fixture_recipe: Several unrelated initiatives are open; the request is an explicit architecture question with no delivery handoff.
cases.prompt: Explain the upstream and downstream dependencies of this component.
expectations: Answers the explicit request without selecting an unrelated pack
No work record or prose-only live spec directory is created
Relevant providers, consumers and unknowns are evidence-cited

cases.fixture_recipe: A repository has inspectable source and product notes but no knowledge bundle or harness engine checkout.
expectations: States missing knowledge and grounds in actual source/documents
Does not treat empty validation as fresh context or invent harness commands
If core authoring is unavailable, reports registration blocked instead of writing JSON directly

cases.fixture_recipe: A legacy active pack and a completed pack are present with prior bytes and owner records.
cases.prompt: Analyze a new change related to the completed initiative.
expectations: Preserves both prior packs and their format/receipts
Creates a distinct gated initiative when runtime is available; never silently adopts or reopens
Historical evidence remains dated and does not become new authority
